text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—Like I said!
I'm totally fine! Mom, seriously!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'm hanging up! I'm really gonna hang up!
I'm hanging up, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? Send some compresses?
...Well, if it's just that, then... sure.
Alright, hanging up now!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Geez, fussing over a little scratch like this...
choice_data_list: Still, you should probably rest for now...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Tsk.
I told you, I'm sick of hearing that!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
No way an injury like this is gonna stop me...!
I can't let myself get looked down on by an injury, or by anyone around me!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading back to the track...!
Time to continue training!
choice_data_list: You have to rest right now!
You need to rest right now!
Let's look for what we can still do even in your current condition.
Let's look for what we can still do, even in your current condition, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading back to the track...!
Time to continue training!
choice_data_list: You have to rest right now!
You need to rest right now!
Let's look for what we can still do even in your current condition.
Let's look for what we can still do, even in your current condition, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Shut up, shut up, shut up!
Just lemme—"
choice_data_list: Your mother will only worry about you even more.
Your mother will only worry about you even more.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
......
......Aaargh!! Dammit!!!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Fine, I get it...
Dammit...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Espoir City finally agreed to take a rest. Afterwards, she appeared to have called home again to reassure them she wouldn't overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'm *saying*, I can do it like usual just fine...!
I'll show ya!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
All right...! Let's do this...!
Just you watch, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Daaaargh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
…………Ngh!?!?
Ow, owwwww, that huuuuuurts!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Espoir City crouched down in pain the moment she started running...
I really shouldn't have pushed her so hard.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: How's thaaat!! Look at this ruuuun!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Hell yeah!
Did you see that, you bastard?!
I don't feel any pain at all anymore!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Serve you right, damn it...!
Hehehe... I'll take a video of you running and send it straight to Mom...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, without pushing herself enough to aggravate her injury,
Espoir City did everything she possibly could.
